data.one_liner: Lightweight and flexible floating window component with dragging and snapping support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a draggable floating window component that can be managed globally or locally within pages. Supports edge snapping, position caching, multi-touch interaction, and screen rotation adaptation.
use_when: You need a floating toolbar, quick access button, or floating video player.
You want floating windows to automatically snap to edges or cache their positions.
avoid_when: You need native system-level floating windows over other apps.
You are using state management paradigms that strictly discourage imperative controllers.
strengths: Supports both global manager and single-page stack modes.
Rich set of event callbacks and configuration for snapping, margins, and dragging behavior.
Adapts well to screen rotation and window resizing.
weaknesses: Recent major version updates introduced breaking API changes.
Limited documentation outside of translations and basic examples.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or permissions are required.
